Class LaminaEngine

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.lamina.LaminaEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Lamina
public class LaminaEngine extends Object implements Lamina
The LaminaEngine type is the live set of Lane pools. Lane.SSH_IO is a cached pool, so each connection can receive its own thread. Lane.LLM_EXEC is a fixed pool of four threads. Lane.GENERAL is a fixed pool of two threads. Lane.TOOL_EXEC is a fixed pool of one thread. Lane.POOL_IO is a cached pool. The pools are ordinary platform threads. The pools are not virtual threads. submit(LaminaTask) places a task on the pool for that task's lane and returns a LaminaHandle. A LaminaHandle wraps the Future that tracks the task.

  • Constructor Details

    • LaminaEngine

      public LaminaEngine(boolean metricsEnabled)
      The constructor builds one pool for each Lane and starts the metrics counters. The metricsEnabled flag is the casserole.lamina.metrics setting. Lane.SSH_IO uses a cached pool whose threads are named lamina-ssh-io- plus a number. Lane.LLM_EXEC uses a fixed pool of four threads named lamina-llm-exec- plus a number. Lane.GENERAL uses a fixed pool of two threads named lamina-general- plus a number. Lane.TOOL_EXEC uses a fixed pool of one thread named lamina-tool-exec- plus a number. Lane.POOL_IO uses a cached pool whose threads are named lamina-pool-io- plus a number. Each worker thread is not a daemon thread. The engine writes Lamina started metrics= and the flag to the info log. The engine is not shut down after this constructor returns.
      Parameters:
      metricsEnabled - true when LaminaMetrics should count work, or false when counting stays off.

  • Method Details

    • submit

      public LaminaHandle submit(LaminaTask task)
      The submit method places one task on the pool for that task's lane. If task is null, the method throws IllegalArgumentException with the message task. If shutdown() has already run, the method throws IllegalStateException with the message Lamina is shut down. If the lane has no pool, the method throws IllegalStateException with the message no pool for followed by the lane. A successful submit calls LaminaMetrics.recordSubmit() before the body starts. The returned LaminaHandle wraps the Future for that body.
      Specified by:
      submit in interface Lamina
      Parameters:
      task - The named work to run.
      Returns:
      The handle that can cancel the work or report whether it has finished.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - The task was null.
      IllegalStateException - The engine is shut down, or the task's lane has no pool.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      The shutdown method stops every pool. The engine is marked shut down before the pools are stopped, so a later submit(LaminaTask) fails. Each pool is stopped with shutdownNow, which interrupts running workers. The method then waits up to five seconds for each pool to finish. If that wait is interrupted, the method sets the interrupt flag on the current thread and continues with the next pool. The engine writes Lamina stopped to the info log after every pool has been asked to stop. A second call stops the pools again and does not create new pools.
      Specified by:
      shutdown in interface Lamina

    • namedFactory

      private static ThreadFactory namedFactory(String lane)
      The namedFactory method builds a ThreadFactory for one lane name. A ThreadFactory is the Java object that creates worker threads. Each thread is named lamina-, then the lane name, then -, then a number that starts at one. The thread is not a daemon thread.
      Parameters:
      lane - The short lane name placed in the thread name.
      Returns:
      The factory that names the threads for that lane.
